PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 1, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 5:00 PM

Alvaro Castillo, Chair  Todd Lemmis, Commissioner
Michele Ware, Vice Chair  Nicholas Santos, Commissioner
Hakim Chambers, Commissioner  Jane Templin, Commissioner
Michael Clemson, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:03 PM, Vice Chair Ware called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware

Commissioners Absent: Chambers, Clemson, Castillo

Also present: Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, Alison Spindler-Ruiz,
Planning Bureau Manager, Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Rosa Garibay,
City Clerk Specialist.

Commissioner Chambers, Commissioner Clemson, and Chair Castillo were excused from the
meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Templin led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56307  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Santos, seconded by Commissioner
  Lemmis, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Chambers, Clemson, Castillo

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

2.  26-56308  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Planning Commission meeting of
  Thursday, September 3, 2026.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Santos, seconded by Commissioner
  Lemmis, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Chambers, Clemson, Castillo

3.  26-56309  Recommendation to determine the finding of conformance with the General Plan is
  not a project under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) per Section
  15378 of the CEQA Guidelines;

  Find the proposed vacation of a segment of Pier B Street (50 feet wide), situated
  south of Block 27 of the Long Beach Harbor Tract, bounded easterly by the
  westerly line of Interstate 710 and bounded westerly by the easterly line of Parcel
  II, and hereto referred to as Parcel 3D, in conformity with the adopted goals and
  policies of the City of Long Beach (City) General Plan (GPC26-003) in the Port-
  Related Industrial (IP) Zoning District (Case No. 2607-38);

  Find the proposed vacation of a segment of Pier C Street (80 feet wide), bounded
  easterly by the westerly line of historical Pico Avenue (vacated), and bounded
  westerly by the southeasterly prolongation of the northeasterly line of the land
  described in the grant deed recorded September 25, 1947 in Book 25112, Page
  361, in the office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, excepting those
  portions lying 30 feet northwesterly and 30 feet southwesterly of the centerline of
  said street, hereto referred to as Parcel 3E, in conformity with the adopted goals
  and policies of the City’s General Plan (GPC25-004) in the Port-Related Industrial
  (IP) Zoning District (Case No. 2607-39);

  Find the proposed vacation of a segment of Caspian Avenue (60 feet wide),
  situated between Block 11 and Block 12, and between Block 15 and Block 16 of
  Long Beach Harbor Tract, bounded northerly by the southerly line of 12th Street
  and bounded southerly by the northerly line of 9th Street, and hereto referred to as
  Parcel 3M, in conformity with the adopted goals and policies of the City’s General
  Plan (GPC26-005) in the Port-Related Industrial (IP) Zoning District (Case No.
  2607-40);

  Find the proposed vacation of a segment of 9th Street (80 to 100 feet wide),
  situated within Long Beach Harbor Tract, bounded easterly by the westerly line of

bounded southwesterly by the northeasterly line of Parcel C, the deed map filed in
Book 5150, Page 66 of Deed Maps, and bounded northerly by the southerly line of
the Pacific Electric Railroad as shown on the map filed in Book 29, Page 60 of
maps, all in the office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, and hereto
referred to as Parcel 4A, in conformity with the adopted goals and policies of the
City’s General Plan (GPC26-006) in the Port-Related Industrial (IP) Zoning District
(Case No. 2607-41). (District 7)

A motion was made by Commissioner Lemmis, seconded by Commissioner
Templin, to approve recommendation, to determine the finding of
conformance with the General Plan is not a project under the California
Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) per Section 15378 of the CEQA
Guidelines. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware
No:  0  None
Recused: 0  None
Abstain: 0  None
Absent: 3  Chambers, Clemson, Castillo

A motion was made by Commissioner Lemmis, seconded by Commissioner
Templin, to approve recommendation, to find the proposed vacation of a
segment of Pier B Street (50 feet wide), situated south of Block 27 of the Long
Beach Harbor Tract, bounded easterly by the westerly line of Interstate 710
and bounded westerly by the easterly line of Parcel II, and hereto referred to
as Parcel 3D, in conformity with the adopted goals and policies of the City of
Long Beach (City) General Plan (GPC26-003) in the Port-Related Industrial (IP)
Zoning District (Case No. 2607-38). The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware
No:  0  None
Recused: 0  None
Abstain: 0  None
Absent: 3  Chambers, Clemson, Castillo

A motion was made by Commissioner Lemmis, seconded by Commissioner
Templin, to approve recommendation, to find the proposed vacation of a
segment of Pier C Street (80 feet wide), bounded easterly by the westerly line
of historical Pico Avenue (vacated), and bounded westerly by the
southeasterly prolongation of the northeasterly line of the land described in
the grant deed recorded September 25, 1947 in Book 25112, Page 361, in the
office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, excepting those
portions lying 30 feet northwesterly and 30 feet southwesterly of the
centerline of said street, hereto referred to as Parcel 3E, in conformity with

A motion was made by Commissioner Lemmis, seconded by Commissioner

Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware

A motion was made by Commissioner Lemmis, seconded by Commissioner
Templin, to approve recommendation, to find the proposed vacation of a
segment of 9th Street (80 to 100 feet wide), situated within Long Beach Harbor

Deed Maps, and bounded northerly by the southerly line of the Pacific Electric

4.  26-56310  Recommendation to receive and file an update on National Community Planning
  Month. (Citywide)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Santos, seconded by Commissioner
  Lemmis, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  4  Lemmis, Santos, Templin, Ware
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None

  Vice Chair Ware spoke.

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke.

PUBLIC COMMENT

There was no public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

There were no announcements.

ADJOURNMENT

At 5:31 PM, there being no objection, Vice Chair Ware declared the meeting adjourned.
